text: The proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel:
For knowing wisdom and discipline, for discerning words of understanding,
for receiving the instruction of wisdom, righteousness, and justice, and uprightness,
for giving to the simple ones prudence, to a youth knowledge and discretion.
Let the wise hear and add to instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel,
to understand a proverb and a parable, the words of the wise ones and their riddles.
The fear of YHWH [is] the beginning of knowledge; wisdom and instruction fools have despised.
Hear, my son, the discipline of your father, and do not forsake the instruction of your mother.
For a garland of grace they [are] to your head, and pendants for your neck.
My son, if sinners should entice you, do not be willing.
If they say, “Come with us, let us lie in wait for blood, let us hide for the innocent one without cause;
let us swallow them alive like Sheol, and whole like those descending into the Pit;
all precious wealth we will find, we will fill our houses with plunder;
let your lot fall in our midst—one purse there shall be for all of us!”—
My son, do not walk in the way with them; withhold your foot from their path;
for their feet run to evil, and they are swift to shed blood.
For the net is spread in vain in the eyes of any owner of the wing,
and they lie in wait for their own blood; they lurk for their own souls.
Such [are] the ways of everyone being greedy for dishonest gain—the soul of its masters it takes away.
Wisdom calls aloud in the street; in the open squares she gives forth her voice.
At the head of the clamoring she cries out; at the openings of the gates in the city she speaks her words:
“Until when, O simple ones, will you⁺ love simplicity, and those mocking delight themselves in mockery, and the foolish ones hate knowledge?
Turn back at my rebuke; behold, I will pour out on you⁺ my spirit; I will make known my words to you⁺.
Because I have called and you⁺ refused, I have stretched out my hand, and no one is paying attention;
and you⁺ have neglected all my counsel, and you⁺ did not consent to my rebuke.
I also will laugh at your⁺ calamity; I will mock the coming of your⁺ dread;
your⁺ dread comes like a storm, and your⁺ calamity like a whirlwind comes, in the coming upon you⁺ of distress and anguish.
Then they will call on me, and I will not answer; they will seek me diligently, and they will not find me,
upon that they hated knowledge and they have not choosen the fear of YHWH.
They did not consent to my counsel; they have despised all my reproof.
And they shall eat the fruit of their own way, and from their own counsels they shall be filled.
For the turning away of the simple ones slays them, and the complacency of fools destroys them.
And the one listening to me will dwell [in] safety, and will be at ease from the dread of evil.”
